newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds look to recapture 102.47 high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds look to recapture 102.47 high.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will push for the 102.47 high on Friday but may find the going difficult amid holiday-thinned markets, technical analysts said.
"We had a really good session yesterday," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "The 102.40,47 levels are the ones to watch on the upside."
Bunds scored a new contract high at 102.47 on Thursday after weaker than expected U.S. June payrolls data gave international debt markets a lift.
September Bunds were quoted at 102.34 at 0641 GMT, down eight basis points on Thursday's pit settlement.
Celaya said if Bunds managed to pierce the contract high they would gravitate to the psychologically important 102.50 area.
A move above there would target the 102.59 level, the high on May 14 on continuation charts, Celaya said.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, was also positive on the contract.
"We take a bullish view having seen the break up, and would look to use short term pullbacks onto what would now be strong supports at 101.88," he said in a research note.
Daily charts show Bunds hit a low of 101.84 on Wednesday before they raced higher on Tuesday.
Celaya said support was thin with the Bund at such lofty heights but an initial buffer would come in at 102.30, followed by the spike higher on July 2 at 102.17.
Below 102.00, the old highs in the 101.90s would come into play, he said.

"If it get gets below 101.90 then it gets really soft for a big sell-off," he said. "But that's probably not going to happen." The U.S. Independence Day holiday would likely curtail trade, analysts said.
At the short end, December Euromarks were quoted at 96.84, static in early trade.
